channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay South Block 16A (UCSF planned)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay South Block 16A (UCSF planned) (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 16A (UCSF planned): Block 16A: the university's May 6, 2026 approval of the Mission Bay Block 16A Building and UCSF's release about the Bakar Ear & Hearing Institute are matched on use, building form and timing; no document read names both. The release gives no approval date, and Addendum #6 is named but not dated in the notice.
item.description: Block 16A: the university's May 6, 2026 approval of the Mission Bay Block 16A Building and UCSF's release about the Bakar Ear & Hearing Institute are matched on use, building form and timing; no document read names both. The release gives no approval date, and Addendum #6 is named but not dated in the notice. Source: Notice of Determination, Mission Bay Block 16A Building (CEQAnet SCH 2013092047); UCSF release via Mirage News, 2026-05-07.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 16A (UCSF planned): Block 16A's notes now say the University of California's May 6, 2026 notice puts a building on Block 16A and part of 16B, and that UCSF's announcement places the Bakar Ear & Hearing Institute at Fifth Street and Nelson Rising Lane. No document names both, so linking them rests on the matching approval date and building description. UCSF expects completion in 2029 and occupancy in 2030; both are expected dates.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 16A (UCSF planned): Block 16A's map notes said it continues the 15A/15B parking lot and that no project had been found. USDA NAIP imagery (viewed 2026-09-29) shows open graded ground rather than parked cars, UCSF's June 2025 deck lists the block as undeveloped research land, and the notes now point to this record's May 2026 UC Regents milestones, whose UCSF source could not be read and whose block location is unconfirmed. The December 2015 map claim in the 2019 milestone is now cited to the Long-Range Property Management Plan.

item.title: Planned · Mission Bay South Block 16A (UCSF planned): The University of California approves the Mission Bay Block 16A Building (Notice of Determination: 153,600 gross sq ft, five above-ground levels with the fifth shelled, donor-developed, for clinical care and research on ear and hearing disorders; location Block 16A and a portion of Block 16B); UCSF's release, republished on May 7, 2026 (Australian time) and giving no approval date, says the Regents approved the Bakar Ear & Hearing Institute. The two are matched here on use, building form and timing; no document read names both (May 6, 2026)
item.description: The University of California approves the Mission Bay Block 16A Building (Notice of Determination: 153,600 gross sq ft, five above-ground levels with the fifth shelled, donor-developed, for clinical care and research on ear and hearing disorders; location Block 16A and a portion of Block 16B); UCSF's release, republished on May 7, 2026 (Australian time) and giving no approval date, says the Regents approved the Bakar Ear & Hearing Institute. The two are matched here on use, building form and timing; no document read names both (May 6, 2026). Source: University of California, Physical & Environmental Planning, 2026-05-06; Mirage News (originating organization: UCSF), 2026-05-07.
